edge_image.note: The 2-element vertex sets [set f x; f y] over adjacent pattern pairs; no host-edge, injectivity or tree condition.

injective_edge_image.note: X47 copy: some injective f with F its image; image edges need not be host edges.

embedded_edge_copy.note: X212 copy: injective, adjacency-preserving, A its image (hence inside E(G)).

edge_decomposition_by_equal_parts.note: X47 decomposition: parts are injective images inside E(G), cover E(G), and are equal when they share an edge; repeated parts allowed; no pattern or part guard.

edge_decomposition_exact.note: X212 decomposition: members are embedded copies and every 2-element set is counted exactly as often as it is a host edge; repeated nonempty parts excluded, repeated empty parts allowed.
